data.description: Radio Juicy is happy to present nazah’s “Return”! Inspired by the great Fela Kuti, the track is built around the idea of finding your way back, unfolding through the interplay of Afrobeat and contemporary jazz. Bee-Z’s trumpet and Bolu Adubi’s bass guide a conversation shaped by harmony and improvisation, with Perdie joining as co-producer. “Return” is a journey back that never stands still, reminding us that sometimes moving forward means returning: https://earlygrooves.com/radiojuicy/return

data.description: Crypto Ravers proudly presents a special release featuring JAW, the iconic voice behind CLAPTONE'S classics like No Eyes and Dear Life. The original comes from Yenge alongside label favorite Freiboitar, delivering a sexy, powerful cut that oozes house class. On remix duties, label bosses Ordonez & Mao Silgrand flip it into a more club-focused weapon while keeping the sultry vibe intact. Rounding off the package, Yenge drops a deep B-side gem that shows his versatility.
